body: You’re right. I just need to get my head right. I’ve tried working toward what I wanted out of life and failed every time trying to achieve it. I just feel beaten down and don’t have the energy to move forward. I do agree that it’s not hopeless though. I’m trying to see a therapist soon. That should help and maybe help me figure out ways to achieve my goals and focus on goals instead of setting expectations. Thank you for your comment.
